$comment: Disease-centred vademecum, phase 1 (SHADOW). The canonical findings the area files reuse, and the policy of the hypothetico-deductive loop (lib/pane-engine/src/vademecum-loop). Finding ids are the PANE feature ids where one exists (pane), sign.<id> for an examination sign (clinical-content/rules/exam-signs.json), rule.<rule>.<band> for a decision-rule band (decision-rules.json), and new ids for findings neither engine had. Every value needs clinical sign-off: docs/clinical-validation/changes/vademecum-phase1.md.
title: Vademecum finding dictionary and loop policy (phase 1, shadow)
reference: Findings seeded from the PANE feature list (lib/pane-engine) and the iOS DiagnosticDatabase.json curated features; examination signs and decision rules referenced from clinical-content/rules. baseRate is PANE's Feature.baseRate (the rate PANE gives a disease that does not model the finding; every PANE-seeded LR+ is P(f|D) / baseRate), or an estimate for new findings; it also feeds the predictive probability of an answer.

policy.note: Every number here is a proposal for sign-off: the prior tiers are PANE's; the test / treat thresholds come from the decision layer (treatment-decisions.json) where a disease names a decision, else these defaults; criteria floors (definite 0.9, suspected 0.5; a diagnostic floor applies only when the Bayesian posterior is at least criteriaMinPosterior 0.01, otherwise the met criteria are reported as a conflict; NG12 referral 0.03 = the NG12 3 % positive predictive value threshold, which sets the test decision without moving the rank), the definitive likelihood ratio (200), the likelihood-ratio clamp (0.02–100: the PANE-seeded scale reaches 99 = 0.99 / 0.01), the conflict thresholds and the criteria bonus are engineering defaults.
